import numpy as np
from statsmodels.tsa.ardl.model import UECM
from statsmodels.tsa.ardl.tests.test_ardl import dane_data

mod = UECM(dane_data.lrm, 3, dane_data[["lry","ibo","ide"]], {"lry":1,"ibo":3,"ide":2})
res = mod.fit()

lhs = np.asarray(res.resid, dtype=float)
rhs = np.asarray(res.model._y - res.fittedvalues, dtype=float)

# Align in case of any internal trimming (should be same length)
minn = min(lhs.shape[0], rhs.shape[0])
lhs2 = lhs[:minn]
rhs2 = rhs[:minn]
diff = lhs2 - rhs2
max_abs = float(np.max(np.abs(diff)))

# Return a few summary stats and a couple of first values
out = {
  "resid_first": lhs2[:5].tolist(),
  "y_minus_fitted_first": rhs2[:5].tolist(),
  "max_abs_diff": max_abs,
  "length_resid": int(lhs2.shape[0]),
  "length_y_minus_fitted": int(rhs2.shape[0]),
}

# Also compute a relative error with scale from rhs
scale = float(np.max(np.abs(rhs2))) if np.max(np.abs(rhs2)) != 0 else 1.0
rel_max = max_abs / scale
out["rel_max_abs_diff"] = float(rel_max)

probe(name="uecm_resid_matches_y_minus_fittedvalues", value=out)
